heading: Connect an app to your mailbox
redirect_label: After you sign in, access goes to
redirect_check: Continue only if you started connecting this app yourself.
can_send: send email and save drafts in your name
can_read: read, search, move and flag your messages, including spam
cannot: It can't delete messages permanently or change your account settings.
password_hint: Use an app password if your mail server offers them.
privacy_password: Your password is checked with your mail server and stored encrypted on this server, so the app can act for you. Access ends when you disconnect the app or after 30 days without use.
privacy_agent: An AI agent with this access can send email as you. Only connect apps you trust, and don't let them send without asking you.
error_domain: This server doesn't accept sign-ins for {domain}.
error_unavailable: The mail server can't be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
expired_body: Go back to your app and connect again.
no_login_body: This server doesn't offer a sign-in method yet. Ask your administrator.
or_password: or sign in with an app password
privacy_mailcow: You sign in on your mailcow's own login page, so this server never sees your password. It creates an app password named “MCP: …” for IMAP, SMTP and contacts only, stored encrypted here. You'll find it in mailcow under App passwords; deleting it there disconnects the app.
error_mailcow_cancelled: The sign-in at mailcow was cancelled.
error_mailcow_failed: Signing in with mailcow didn't work. Try again; if it keeps failing, ask your administrator.
error_mailcow_unavailable: mailcow can't be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error_domain_mailcow: This server doesn't accept sign-ins for your domain.
error_cross_origin: This sign-in page was submitted from another site. Go back to your app and connect again.
can_drafts: save drafts in your name for you to send (this server doesn't send mail)
privacy_agent_drafts: An AI agent with this access can write drafts in your name; you send them yourself. Only connect apps you trust.
connect_heading: Add a mailbox to a connection
connect_to: This signs another mailbox into {client}, which already uses {mailboxes}.
connect_check: Continue only if you asked {client} to add a mailbox. It will be able to use this mailbox like the others.
connect_session_hint: If this browser is signed in to mailcow as another mailbox, mailcow uses that one: open this page in a private window, or sign out of mailcow first.
connect_done_body: {mailbox} is now connected to {client}. Go back to {client}.
connect_already_body: {mailbox} is already connected to {client}. To add a different mailbox, ask {client} for a new link and sign in as that mailbox.
connect_full_body: This connection already has as many mailboxes as it can have. Remove one first.
connect_expired_body: Links for adding a mailbox work once and for 15 minutes. Ask your app for a new one.
